# FoundMyFitness

> A science-backed platform for optimizing healthspan through evidence-based research on nutrition, exercise, supplementation, and longevity led by Dr. Rhonda Patrick.

FoundMyFitness provides comprehensive resources including interview episodes, topic guides, and premium tools like genome analysis and curated research summaries. The platform combines peer-reviewed science with practical health optimization strategies across aging, brain health, fitness, and nutrition.

## Key Topics

- Dr. Rhonda Patrick
- Longevity Science
- BDNF (Brain-Derived Neurotrophic Factor)
- NAD Metabolism
- Nutrition & Supplementation
- Exercise Physiology
- Brain Health
- Inflammation
- Cardiovascular Health
- Immune Function
- Sleep Science
- Testosterone Optimization
- Alzheimer's Disease
- Premium Membership
- Genome Analysis

## Core Platform

- [FoundMyFitness Homepage](https://www.foundmyfitness.com): Main hub for scientific platform on healthspan optimization led by Dr. Rhonda Patrick
- [Episode Library](https://www.foundmyfitness.com/episodes): Comprehensive collection of interviews on aging, health, nutrition, and fitness science
- [Topic Directory](https://www.foundmyfitness.com/topics): Curated reference guides covering nutrition, supplements, exercise, and health research

## Premium Membership & Tools

- [FMF Premium Membership](https://www.foundmyfitness.com/crowdsponsor): Premium membership access to Q&As, podcasts, Science Digest, and genome analysis tools
- [Live Q&A Sessions](https://www.foundmyfitness.com/ask-me-anything): Exclusive live question-and-answer sessions with Dr. Rhonda Patrick for premium members
- [Science Digest Newsletter](https://www.foundmyfitness.com/science-digest): Premium curated research summaries on health science and fitness delivered regularly
- [The Aliquot Podcast](https://www.foundmyfitness.com/aliquot): Premium weekly podcast featuring curated topic episodes from FoundMyFitness content
- [Genome Analysis Tool](https://www.foundmyfitness.com/genetics): DNA analysis platform converting genetic data into personalized health reports

## Featured Episodes

- [NAD Levels & Aging with Dr. Charles Brenner](https://www.foundmyfitness.com/episodes/charles-brenner): Deep dive on NAD supplementation for recovery, inflammation reduction, and slowing aging
- [Best Exercise for Longevity](https://www.foundmyfitness.com/episodes/exercise-intensity): Exercise intensity and longevity science with exercise physiologist Brady Holmer
- [Sleep Science & Insomnia with Dr. Michael Grandner](https://www.foundmyfitness.com/episodes/michael-grandner): Comprehensive sleep science, insomnia treatment, and sleep apnea solutions
- [Natural Testosterone Optimization](https://www.foundmyfitness.com/episodes/more-plates-more-dates): Evidence-based testosterone optimization strategies with Derek from More Plates More Dates
- [Exercise Reverses Poor Sleep Effects](https://www.foundmyfitness.com/episodes/exercise-reverses-effects-of-poor-sleep): HIIT exercise benefits for sleep deprivation recovery and glucose metabolism
- [Eliminate Brain Fog](https://www.foundmyfitness.com/episodes/eliminate-brain-fog): Brain fog solutions through meal timing, exercise, and omega-3 supplementation

## Supplementation & Nutrients

- [Vitamin C](https://www.foundmyfitness.com/topics/vitamin-c): Comprehensive guide to vitamin C properties, supplementation types, and health benefits
- [Omega-3 Fatty Acids](https://www.foundmyfitness.com/topics/omega-3): Omega-3 supplementation for inflammation reduction and brain health optimization
- [Zinc](https://www.foundmyfitness.com/topics/zinc): Zinc nutrient roles in immunity, protein synthesis, and DNA health
- [BDNF (Brain-Derived Neurotrophic Factor)](https://www.foundmyfitness.com/topics/bdnf): BDNF growth factor roles in neuronal health and exercise-induced benefits
